about: The CSC13 test cut (R98): p2.10a to p2.10f of full_take02 in David's clone (R94). Planned against runs/csc13_test_20261012 (a copy of full_take02's recording).

action.text: I have a CSV of U.S. flight data. Build me a single interactive dashboard for an aviation operations team. Use data visualization best practices. Create calculated fields, filters, and parameters where they make sense. Don't limit yourself to just what's in the data; apply what you know about the airline industry and current trends to decide what's useful. Visuals should interact with each other where appropriate. Before you start building, tell me what options we have and ask any questions you need answered. Note that I want the dashboard to run here in my Codespace so I can open it in my browser. The file is at: data/monthlysummary.csv

narration.text: Now let's ask for the dashboard. I'll enter the dashboard prompt.

steps.notes: Typed at natural speed, not pasted (R67): the edit speeds the typing up or cuts its middle, so the line plays over the finished prompt. The description carries every prompt.
